---- MODULE Zab ----
EXTENDS ZabDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL FSThm  == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems
LOCAL SeqThm == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems

(***************************************************************************)
(* Finite-set facts, restated with the unprefixed operators.               *)
(***************************************************************************)

LEMMA H_FSEmpty == IsFiniteSet({})
  BY FSThm!FS_EmptySet DEF FSThm!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

LEMMA H_FSSingleton == ASSUME NEW x PROVE IsFiniteSet({x})
  BY FSThm!FS_Singleton DEF FSThm!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

LEMMA H_FSUnion == ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), NEW T, IsFiniteSet(T)
                   PROVE  IsFiniteSet(S \cup T)
  BY FSThm!FS_Union DEF FSThm!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

LEMMA H_FSDiff == ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), NEW T
                  PROVE  IsFiniteSet(S \ T)
  BY FSThm!FS_Difference DEF FSThm!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

LEMMA H_FSImage == ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), NEW Op(_)
                   PROVE  IsFiniteSet({Op(x) : x \in S})
  BY FSThm!FS_Image DEF FSThm!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

LEMMA H_FSIsFin == \A S : FSThm!IsFiniteSet(S) <=> IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY DEF FSThm!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

LEMMA H_FSInduction ==
  ASSUME NEW S, FSThm!IsFiniteSet(S), NEW P(_), P({}),
         ASSUME NEW T \in SUBSET S, FSThm!IsFiniteSet(T), P(T), NEW x \in S \ T
         PROVE  P(T \cup {x})
  PROVE  P(S)
  BY FSThm!FS_Induction

(***************************************************************************)
(* Maxima of finite sets.                                                  *)
(***************************************************************************)

LEMMA H_MaxRel ==
  ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), S # {}, NEW R(_,_),
         \A a, b \in S : R(a,b) \/ R(b,a),
         \A a, b, c \in S : R(a,b) /\ R(b,c) => R(a,c)
  PROVE  \E x \in S : \A y \in S : R(x,y)
  <1> DEFINE P(T) == (T # {}) => \E x \in T : \A y \in T : R(x,y)
  <1>1 P({}) OBVIOUS
  <1>2 ASSUME NEW T \in SUBSET S, FSThm!IsFiniteSet(T), P(T), NEW z \in S \ T
       PROVE  P(T \cup {z})
    <2>1 CASE T = {}
      BY <1>2, <2>1 DEF P
    <2>2 CASE T # {}
      <3>1 PICK x \in T : \A y \in T : R(x,y)  BY <1>2, <2>2 DEF P
      <3>x x \in S /\ z \in S BY <1>2
      <3>2 CASE R(z,x)
        <4>1 \A y \in T \cup {z} : R(z,y)
          <5>1 ASSUME NEW y \in T PROVE R(z,y)
            BY <1>2, <3>1, <3>2, <3>x
          <5>2 R(z,z) BY <3>x
          <5> QED BY <5>1, <5>2
        <4> QED BY <4>1 DEF P
      <3>3 CASE ~R(z,x)
        <4>1 R(x,z) BY <3>3, <3>x
        <4>2 \A y \in T \cup {z} : R(x,y) BY <3>1, <4>1
        <4> QED BY <4>2, <3>1 DEF P
      <3> QED BY <3>2, <3>3
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2
  <1>3 P(S)
    <2>a FSThm!IsFiniteSet(S) BY H_FSIsFin
    <2> HIDE DEF P
    <2> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <2>a, H_FSInduction, IsaM("blast")
  <1> QED BY <1>3 DEF P

LEMMA H_MaxIntExists ==
  ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), S # {}, S \subseteq Int
  PROVE  \E x \in S : \A y \in S : x >= y
  <1>1 \A a, b \in S : a >= b \/ b >= a BY SMTT("r20")
  <1>2 \A a, b, c \in S : (a >= b /\ b >= c) => a >= c BY SMTT("r20")
  <1> DEFINE R(a,b) == a >= b
  <1>3 \A a, b \in S : R(a,b) \/ R(b,a) BY <1>1
  <1>4 \A a, b, c \in S : R(a,b) /\ R(b,c) => R(a,c) BY <1>2
  <1> QED BY <1>3, <1>4, H_MaxRel

LEMMA H_MaximumProps ==
  ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S), S \subseteq Int
  PROVE  /\ Maximum(S) \in Int
         /\ S # {} => (Maximum(S) \in S /\ \A y \in S : Maximum(S) >= y)
  <1>1 CASE S = {}
    BY <1>1 DEF Maximum
  <1>2 CASE S # {}
    <2>1 \E x \in S : \A y \in S : x >= y BY <1>2, H_MaxIntExists
    <2>2 Maximum(S) = CHOOSE n \in S : \A m \in S : n >= m BY <1>2 DEF Maximum
    <2>3 (CHOOSE n \in S : \A m \in S : n >= m) \in S
         /\ \A m \in S : (CHOOSE n \in S : \A m2 \in S : n >= m2) >= m
      BY <2>1
    <2> QED BY <2>2, <2>3
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2

(***************************************************************************)
(* Finite sequences over an unspecified element set.                       *)
(***************************************************************************)

H_FinSeq(q) == \E SS : q \in Seq(SS)

LEMMA H_FSeqEmpty == H_FinSeq(<< >>)
  BY SeqThm!EmptySeq DEF H_FinSeq

LEMMA H_FSeqLen ==
  ASSUME NEW q, H_FinSeq(q)
  PROVE  /\ Len(q) \in Nat
         /\ DOMAIN q = 1..Len(q)
  <1>1 PICK SS : q \in Seq(SS) BY DEF H_FinSeq
  <1> QED BY <1>1, SeqThm!LenProperties

LEMMA H_FSeqAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW q, H_FinSeq(q), NEW e
  PROVE  /\ H_FinSeq(Append(q, e))
         /\ Len(Append(q, e)) = Len(q) + 1
         /\ \A k \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q, e)[k] = q[k]
         /\ Append(q, e)[Len(q) + 1] = e
  <1>1 PICK SS : q \in Seq(SS) BY DEF H_FinSeq
  <1>2 q \in Seq(SS \cup {e}) BY <1>1, SeqThm!SeqMonotonic
  <1>3 e \in SS \cup {e} OBVIOUS
  <1> QED BY <1>2, <1>3, SeqThm!AppendProperties DEF H_FinSeq

LEMMA H_FSeqTail ==
  ASSUME NEW q, H_FinSeq(q), q # << >>
  PROVE  /\ H_FinSeq(Tail(q))
         /\ Len(q) \in Nat \ {0}
         /\ Len(Tail(q)) = Len(q) - 1
         /\ \A k \in 1..Len(Tail(q)) : Tail(q)[k] = q[k+1]
  <1>1 PICK SS : q \in Seq(SS) BY DEF H_FinSeq
  <1> QED BY <1>1, SeqThm!HeadTailProperties, SeqThm!EmptySeq DEF H_FinSeq

LEMMA H_FSeqElt ==
  ASSUME NEW q, H_FinSeq(q), q # << >>
  PROVE  1 \in 1..Len(q)
  BY H_FSeqTail, H_FSeqLen

(***************************************************************************)
(* Reduced type invariant: everything needed for the leadership properties *)
(* (it deliberately says nothing about history / lastCommitted contents).  *)
(***************************************************************************)

H_CInfo == [sid : Server, connected : BOOLEAN, epoch : Nat]

H_MsgP(m) == (m.mtype = CEPOCH \/ m.mtype = NEWEPOCH) => m.mepoch \in Nat

H_QOK(q) == H_FinSeq(q) /\ \A k \in 1..Len(q) : H_MsgP(q[k])

H_TypeB ==
  /\ state         \in [Server -> {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}]
  /\ zabState      \in [Server -> {ELECTION, DISCOVERY, SYNCHRONIZATION, BROADCAST}]
  /\ acceptedEpoch \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ currentEpoch  \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ learners      \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
  /\ cepochRecv    \in [Server -> SUBSET H_CInfo]
  /\ \A s \in Server : IsFiniteSet(cepochRecv[s])
  /\ ackeRecv      = [s \in Server |-> ackeRecv[s]]
  /\ ackldRecv     = [s \in Server |-> ackldRecv[s]]
  /\ \A s \in Server : \A x \in ackeRecv[s]  : x.sid \in Server
  /\ \A s \in Server : \A x \in ackldRecv[s] : x.sid \in Server
  /\ sendCounter   \in [Server -> Nat]
  /\ connectInfo   \in [Server -> Server \cup {NullPoint}]
  /\ leaderOracle  \in Server \cup {NullPoint}
  /\ msgs          = [a \in Server |-> [b \in Server |-> msgs[a][b]]]
  /\ \A a, b \in Server : H_QOK(msgs[a][b])
  /\ epochLeader   \in [1..MAXEPOCH -> SUBSET Server]

LEMMA H_InitTypeB == Init => H_TypeB
  <1> SUFFICES ASSUME Init PROVE H_TypeB OBVIOUS
  <1> USE DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitLeaderVars, InitFollowerVars,
              InitElectionVars, InitVerifyVars, InitMsgVars
  <1>1 \A s \in Server : IsFiniteSet(cepochRecv[s]) BY H_FSEmpty
  <1>2 \A a, b \in Server : H_QOK(msgs[a][b])
    BY H_FSeqEmpty, SeqThm!EmptySeq DEF H_QOK
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, MaxEpochNat DEF H_TypeB, LOOKING, ELECTION

LEMMA H_QOKEmpty == H_QOK(<< >>)
  BY H_FSeqEmpty, SeqThm!EmptySeq DEF H_QOK

LEMMA H_QOKAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW q, H_QOK(q), NEW m, H_MsgP(m)
  PROVE  H_QOK(Append(q, m))
  <1>1 H_FinSeq(Append(q,m)) /\ Len(Append(q,m)) = Len(q) + 1
       /\ (\A k \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q,m)[k] = q[k])
       /\ Append(q,m)[Len(q)+1] = m
    BY H_FSeqAppend DEF H_QOK
  <1>2 Len(q) \in Nat BY H_FSeqLen DEF H_QOK
  <1>3 \A k \in 1..Len(Append(q,m)) : H_MsgP(Append(q,m)[k])
    <2> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW k \in 1..Len(Append(q,m)) PROVE H_MsgP(Append(q,m)[k])
      OBVIOUS
    <2>1 k \in 1..Len(q) \/ k = Len(q)+1 BY <1>1, <1>2
    <2> QED BY <1>1, <2>1 DEF H_QOK
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>3 DEF H_QOK

LEMMA H_QOKTail ==
  ASSUME NEW q, H_QOK(q), q # << >>
  PROVE  H_QOK(Tail(q))
  <1>1 /\ H_FinSeq(Tail(q))
       /\ Len(q) \in Nat \ {0}
       /\ Len(Tail(q)) = Len(q) - 1
       /\ \A k \in 1..Len(Tail(q)) : Tail(q)[k] = q[k+1]
    BY H_FSeqTail DEF H_QOK
  <1>2 \A k \in 1..Len(Tail(q)) : H_MsgP(Tail(q)[k])
    BY <1>1 DEF H_QOK
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF H_QOK

LEMMA H_QOKHead ==
  ASSUME NEW q, H_QOK(q), q # << >>
  PROVE  H_MsgP(q[1])
  BY H_FSeqElt DEF H_QOK

(***************************************************************************)
(* Typing of the record-set updates.                                       *)
(***************************************************************************)

LEMMA H_MaxEpochNat ==
  ASSUME NEW cr, cr \subseteq H_CInfo, IsFiniteSet(cr)
  PROVE  Maximum({c.epoch : c \in cr}) + 1 \in Nat
  <1> DEFINE ES == {c.epoch : c \in cr}
  <1>1 IsFiniteSet(ES) BY H_FSImage
  <1>2 ES \subseteq Nat BY DEF H_CInfo
  <1>3 ES \subseteq Int BY <1>2
  <1>4 Maximum(ES) \in Int BY <1>1, <1>3, H_MaximumProps
  <1>5 CASE ES = {}
    BY <1>5 DEF Maximum
  <1>6 CASE ES # {}
    <2>1 Maximum(ES) \in ES BY <1>1, <1>3, <1>6, H_MaximumProps
    <2> QED BY <2>1, <1>2
  <1> QED BY <1>5, <1>6

LEMMA H_UpdCepochType ==
  ASSUME NEW st, st \subseteq H_CInfo, IsFiniteSet(st), NEW sid \in Server, NEW pe \in Nat
  PROVE  /\ UpdateCepochRecv(st, sid, pe) \subseteq H_CInfo
         /\ IsFiniteSet(UpdateCepochRecv(st, sid, pe))
  <1> DEFINE ni == [ sid |-> sid, connected |-> TRUE, epoch |-> pe ]
  <1>0 ni \in H_CInfo BY DEF H_CInfo
  <1>1 CASE sid \notin {x.sid : x \in st}
    BY <1>0, <1>1, H_FSSingleton, H_FSUnion DEF UpdateCepochRecv
  <1>2 CASE sid \in {x.sid : x \in st}
    <2>1 (CHOOSE x \in st : x.sid = sid) \in st BY <1>2
    <2>2 IsFiniteSet((st \ {CHOOSE x \in st : x.sid = sid}) \cup {ni})
      BY H_FSDiff, H_FSSingleton, H_FSUnion
    <2> QED BY <1>0, <1>2, <2>2 DEF UpdateCepochRecv
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA H_RemCepochType ==
  ASSUME NEW st, st \subseteq H_CInfo, IsFiniteSet(st), NEW sid
  PROVE  /\ RemoveCepochRecv(st, sid) \subseteq H_CInfo
         /\ IsFiniteSet(RemoveCepochRecv(st, sid))
  <1>1 CASE sid \notin {x.sid : x \in st}
    BY <1>1 DEF RemoveCepochRecv
  <1>2 CASE sid \in {x.sid : x \in st}
    <2> DEFINE inf == CHOOSE x \in st : x.sid = sid
    <2>1 inf \in st BY <1>2
    <2>2 inf \in H_CInfo BY <2>1
    <2>3 inf.sid = sid BY <1>2
    <2>4 [ sid |-> sid, connected |-> FALSE, epoch |-> inf.epoch ] \in H_CInfo
      BY <2>2, <2>3 DEF H_CInfo
    <2>5 IsFiniteSet((st \ {inf}) \cup
                     {[ sid |-> sid, connected |-> FALSE, epoch |-> inf.epoch ]})
      BY H_FSDiff, H_FSSingleton, H_FSUnion
    <2> QED BY <1>2, <2>4, <2>5 DEF RemoveCepochRecv
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA H_UpdAckeSid ==
  ASSUME NEW st, \A x \in st : x.sid \in Server, NEW sid \in Server,
         NEW pe, NEW ph
  PROVE  \A x \in UpdateAckeRecv(st, sid, pe, ph) : x.sid \in Server
  BY DEF UpdateAckeRecv

LEMMA H_RemAckeSid ==
  ASSUME NEW st, \A x \in st : x.sid \in Server, NEW sid
  PROVE  \A x \in RemoveAckeRecv(st, sid) : x.sid \in Server
  <1>1 CASE sid \notin {x.sid : x \in st}
    BY <1>1 DEF RemoveAckeRecv
  <1>2 CASE sid \in {x.sid : x \in st}
    <2>1 (CHOOSE x \in st : x.sid = sid) \in st /\ (CHOOSE x \in st : x.sid = sid).sid = sid
      BY <1>2
    <2> QED BY <1>2, <2>1 DEF RemoveAckeRecv
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA H_UpdAckldSid ==
  ASSUME NEW st, \A x \in st : x.sid \in Server, NEW sid \in Server
  PROVE  \A x \in UpdateAckldRecv(st, sid) : x.sid \in Server
  BY DEF UpdateAckldRecv

LEMMA H_RemAckldSid ==
  ASSUME NEW st, \A x \in st : x.sid \in Server, NEW sid
  PROVE  \A x \in RemoveAckldRecv(st, sid) : x.sid \in Server
  <1>1 CASE sid \notin {x.sid : x \in st}
    BY <1>1 DEF RemoveAckldRecv
  <1>2 CASE sid \in {x.sid : x \in st}
    <2>1 (CHOOSE x \in st : x.sid = sid) \in st /\ (CHOOSE x \in st : x.sid = sid).sid = sid
      BY <1>2
    <2> QED BY <1>2, <2>1 DEF RemoveAckldRecv
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA H_RemoveLearnerTypeB ==
  ASSUME H_TypeB, NEW i \in Server, NEW j, RemoveLearner(i, j)
  PROVE  /\ learners'   \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
         /\ cepochRecv' \in [Server -> SUBSET H_CInfo]
         /\ \A s \in Server : IsFiniteSet(cepochRecv'[s])
         /\ ackeRecv'  = [s \in Server |-> ackeRecv'[s]]
         /\ ackldRecv' = [s \in Server |-> ackldRecv'[s]]
         /\ \A s \in Server : \A x \in ackeRecv'[s]  : x.sid \in Server
         /\ \A s \in Server : \A x \in ackldRecv'[s] : x.sid \in Server
  BY H_RemCepochType, H_RemAckeSid, H_RemAckldSid DEF RemoveLearner, H_TypeB

(***************************************************************************)
(* Shape lemmas for the message matrix.                                    *)
(***************************************************************************)

H_Mtx(mm) == mm = [x \in Server |-> [y \in Server |-> mm[x][y]]]

LEMMA H_MtxDom == ASSUME NEW mm, H_Mtx(mm), NEW x \in Server
                  PROVE  DOMAIN mm = Server /\ DOMAIN mm[x] = Server
  BY DEF H_Mtx

LEMMA H_MtxUpd1 ==
  ASSUME NEW mm, H_Mtx(mm), NEW a \in Server, NEW b \in Server, NEW X
  PROVE  /\ H_Mtx([mm EXCEPT ![a][b] = X])
         /\ \A x \in Server, y \in Server :
               [mm EXCEPT ![a][b] = X][x][y] = IF x = a /\ y = b THEN X ELSE mm[x][y]
  BY H_MtxDom DEF H_Mtx

LEMMA H_MtxUpd2 ==
  ASSUME NEW mm, H_Mtx(mm), NEW a \in Server, NEW b \in Server,
         NEW c \in Server, NEW d \in Server, NEW X, NEW Y
  PROVE  /\ H_Mtx([mm EXCEPT ![a][b] = X, ![c][d] = Y])
         /\ \A x \in Server, y \in Server :
               [mm EXCEPT ![a][b] = X, ![c][d] = Y][x][y] =
                  IF x = c /\ y = d THEN Y
                  ELSE IF x = a /\ y = b THEN X ELSE mm[x][y]
  BY H_MtxDom DEF H_Mtx

LEMMA H_MtxRowV ==
  ASSUME NEW mm, H_Mtx(mm), NEW a \in Server, NEW RowF,
         RowF = [v \in Server |-> RowF[v]]
  PROVE  /\ H_Mtx([mm EXCEPT ![a] = RowF])
         /\ \A x \in Server, y \in Server :
               [mm EXCEPT ![a] = RowF][x][y] = IF x = a THEN RowF[y] ELSE mm[x][y]
  BY H_MtxDom DEF H_Mtx

LEMMA H_MtxUpdRowV ==
  ASSUME NEW mm, H_Mtx(mm), NEW a \in Server, NEW b \in Server, NEW c \in Server,
         NEW X, NEW RowF, RowF = [v \in Server |-> RowF[v]]
  PROVE  /\ H_Mtx([mm EXCEPT ![a][b] = X, ![c] = RowF])
         /\ \A x \in Server, y \in Server :
               [mm EXCEPT ![a][b] = X, ![c] = RowF][x][y] =
                  IF x = c THEN RowF[y] ELSE IF x = a /\ y = b THEN X ELSE mm[x][y]
  BY H_MtxDom DEF H_Mtx

LEMMA H_MtxCleanV ==
  ASSUME NEW mm, H_Mtx(mm), NEW S
  PROVE  /\ H_Mtx([s \in Server |-> [v \in Server |-> IF v \in S THEN << >> ELSE mm[s][v]]])
         /\ \A x \in Server, y \in Server :
               [s \in Server |-> [v \in Server |-> IF v \in S THEN << >> ELSE mm[s][v]]][x][y]
                  = IF y \in S THEN << >> ELSE mm[x][y]
  BY DEF H_Mtx

(***************************************************************************)
(* Message-matrix update helpers specialised to msgs.                      *)
(***************************************************************************)

LEMMA H_MsgsOne ==
  ASSUME H_TypeB, NEW a \in Server, NEW b \in Server, NEW X, H_QOK(X),
         NEW nn, nn = [msgs EXCEPT ![a][b] = X]
  PROVE  H_Mtx(nn) /\ \A x, y \in Server : H_QOK(nn[x][y])
  <1>m H_Mtx(msgs) BY DEF H_TypeB, H_Mtx
  <1>1 H_Mtx(nn) BY <1>m, H_MtxUpd1
  <1>2 \A x \in Server, y \in Server :
          nn[x][y] = IF x = a /\ y = b THEN X ELSE msgs[x][y]
    BY <1>m, H_MtxUpd1
  <1>3 \A x \in Server, y \in Server : H_QOK(nn[x][y]) BY <1>2 DEF H_TypeB
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>3

LEMMA H_MsgsTwo ==
  ASSUME H_TypeB, NEW a \in Server, NEW b \in Server,
         NEW c \in Server, NEW d \in Server,
         NEW X, H_QOK(X), NEW Y, H_QOK(Y),
         NEW nn, nn = [msgs EXCEPT ![a][b] = X, ![c][d] = Y]
  PROVE  H_Mtx(nn) /\ \A x, y \in Server : H_QOK(nn[x][y])
  <1>m H_Mtx(msgs) BY DEF H_TypeB, H_Mtx
  <1>1 H_Mtx(nn) BY <1>m, H_MtxUpd2
  <1>2 \A x \in Server, y \in Server :
          nn[x][y] = IF x = c /\ y = d THEN Y
                     ELSE IF x = a /\ y = b THEN X ELSE msgs[x][y]
    BY <1>m, H_MtxUpd2
  <1>3 \A x \in Server, y \in Server : H_QOK(nn[x][y]) BY <1>2 DEF H_TypeB
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>3

LEMMA H_MsgsRow ==
  ASSUME H_TypeB, NEW c \in Server, NEW RF, RF = [v \in Server |-> RF[v]],
         \A v \in Server : H_QOK(RF[v]),
         NEW nn, nn = [msgs EXCEPT ![c] = RF]
  PROVE  H_Mtx(nn) /\ \A x, y \in Server : H_QOK(nn[x][y])
  <1>m H_Mtx(msgs) BY DEF H_TypeB, H_Mtx
  <1>1 H_Mtx(nn) BY <1>m, H_MtxRowV
  <1>2 \A x \in Server, y \in Server :
          nn[x][y] = IF x = c THEN RF[y] ELSE msgs[x][y]
    BY <1>m, H_MtxRowV
  <1>3 \A x \in Server, y \in Server : H_QOK(nn[x][y]) BY <1>2 DEF H_TypeB
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>3

LEMMA H_MsgsBcast ==
  ASSUME H_TypeB, NEW a \in Server, NEW b \in Server, NEW c \in Server,
         NEW X, H_QOK(X), NEW RF, RF = [v \in Server |-> RF[v]],
         \A v \in Server : H_QOK(RF[v]),
         NEW nn, nn = [msgs EXCEPT ![a][b] = X, ![c] = RF]
  PROVE  H_Mtx(nn) /\ \A x, y \in Server : H_QOK(nn[x][y])
  <1>m H_Mtx(msgs) BY DEF H_TypeB, H_Mtx
  <1>1 H_Mtx(nn) BY <1>m, H_MtxUpdRowV
  <1>2 \A x \in Server, y \in Server :
          nn[x][y] = IF x = c THEN RF[y]
                     ELSE IF x = a /\ y = b THEN X ELSE msgs[x][y]
    BY <1>m, H_MtxUpdRowV
  <1>3 \A x \in Server, y \in Server : H_QOK(nn[x][y]) BY <1>2 DEF H_TypeB
  <1> QED BY <1>1, <1>3

LEMMA H_MsgsClean ==
  ASSUME H_TypeB, NEW S,
         NEW nn, nn = [s \in Server |-> [v \in Server |->
                          IF v \in S THEN << >> ELSE msgs[s][v]]]
  PROVE  H_Mtx(nn) /\ \A x, y \in Server : H_QOK(nn[x][y])
  <1>m H_Mtx(msgs) BY DEF H_TypeB, H_Mtx
  <1>1 H_Mtx(nn) BY <1>m, H_MtxCleanV
  <1>2 \A x \in Server, y \in Server :
          nn[x][y] = IF y \in S THEN << >> ELSE msgs[x][y]
    BY <1>m, H_MtxCleanV
  <1>3 \A x \in Server, y \in Server : H_QOK(nn[x][y])
